desc: Howard, in an orange shirt, angrily talking on the phone at the canteen, moves his hand all over his face with eyes closed.
Raj, in a red sweatshirt, is smiling while talking at the canteen table, while Sheldon, Howard, and Leonard look at him with a serious expression.
Leonard, in a blue shirt and green jacket, comes from the kitchen and sits down, placing green and yellow cans on the glass table.
Sheldon, in a purple shirt with black sleeves, suddenly moves his body while sitting on the couch and starts to clap as he is singing a song.
Sheldon, in a purple shirt, gets up and goes to the desk under the window to pick up documents to hand out to the others.
Sheldon, in a purple shirt, rests his elbow on the arm of the couch, holding a paper in his other hand.
Raj and Howard are on their laptops in the living room as they watch Leonard, standing next to the whiteboard, resting his chin on his hand.
Sheldon, in a purple shirt, sits down on the couch next to Howard and raises his shoulders suddenly.
Sheldon, in a purple shirt, shakes his right index finger, makes an okay sign with his hand and then puts his right index finger to his lips.
Leonard, in red robe, walks into the living room to find Sheldon surrounded by white boards.
Sheldon caps his marker and places it by one of the many white boards in the living room.
Leonard, in a red robe, pour himself a cup of coffee to a brown mug.
Sheldon hands Raj a black mug from a brown bag, as he is sitting at a canteen.
Sheldon reaches into a paper bag and pulls out two key chains while sitting at the canteen.
Sheldon takes two can koozies from a paper bag, while sitting at the canteen.
Howard holds a mobile phone up to a whiteboard and uses it to take a photo.
Sheldon, in a blue shirt, sets a speaker on the desk and then sits down.
Leonard gets up from the couch and goes to Sheldon's desk, where Sheldon is strangely moving both his hands above something.
Sheldon walks out of the apartment with electrical gear in his hands and then walks towards the stairs.
Penny enters the apartment building and stops when she sees Sheldon, with electrical gear, sitting on the stairs.
Penny taps her phone screen with her finger while sitting next to Sheldon on the stairs.
Leonard, in a black vest, looks at a notebook, then at his computer screen, and turns back to face Howard and Raj sitting in the living room.
Leonard, in a black vest, gets up from his desk with a notebook in his hand, walks over, and sits on the couch, next to Howard.
Penny, in a white shirt and mustard vest, stands at the doorway, smiles, lifts her index finger, and closes the door.
Sheldon moves his hand back and forth in the air over an electronic device that is lying in his lap, while sitting on the couch with Penny.
Penny puts her hands together and quickly claps twice as she is talking to Sheldon with an electronic device lying in his lap.
Penny stands up from the couch and Sheldon puts the electronic device on the table, then picks up his mug.
Penny, in a white shirt and mustard vest, is sitting next to Sheldon on the couch when he winks at her.
Leonard, in a black vest, is leaning to show Sheldon something on the phone.
Sheldon rapidly stands up from the couch and walks up to the whiteboard to erase everything.
A shot of Penny taking a photo on her phone of the shoes on the table while Sheldon sits in the armchair with his laptop on his lap.
